Try it

Form: Return to the point; name the limit or next step; release the turn.

Close a short explanation in one sentence, then ask a listener to restate the takeaway and what remains open.

Self-check

Does the close add orientation rather than merely announce that the talk is ending?

Limits and next test
  • No audio/video review. Hymn references and attributed quotations are not analyzed as measured singing or prosody.
  • Fused words, bracketed names and awkward negation remain source-quality issues; no silent correction from memory.
  • Reported numbers, institutional claims, political positions and histories are not independently fact-checked.
  • Full retained-caption reading is not proof of full original-event coverage, independent agreement or practical effectiveness.

Compare returns to metaphors, figures and example lists with complete speeches lacking these structures; distinguish testimony from verified outcomes and test audience understanding separately.
